entries.wording: Electronic notification of order creation received.
entries.note: JS Express's first row: the shop's order data, before its warehouse has the parcel.
JS Express's warehouse took the parcel.
At JS Express's Chinese warehouse, after the outbound sorting scan and before the departure from origin.
The step after the allocation began, still before the departure from origin.

entries.wording: Arrive at international airport to abroad

entries.note: The flight's first landing, before a connecting flight.
The destination airport's ground handling agent reports the shipment arrived.

entries.wording: The goods have been picked up abroad
entries.note: The destination agent took the shipment from the airport; JS Express accepted the parcel long before.
The shipment entered a customs warehouse to wait for its clearance.
Relayed by ParcelsApp after the import release at the destination airport, before the destination courier has the parcel.

entries.wording: The cargo tally in the supervised warehouse is in progress.
entries.note: Relayed by ParcelsApp after the import release: the bonded warehouse counting the shipment's pieces, no new customs step.
Handed to the destination courier.

entries.wording: Package Received with Origin Scan warehouse
entries.note: The destination courier's first scan; the adapter moves the place the courier appends into the location.

entries.wording: Package is received at a Straightship station
entries.note: A Canadian courier's depot scan, with its place moved into the location.
GOFO's sorting scan in the United States, after the hand-off to the local courier.

entries.wording: Arrived at GOFO Regional Destination Facility

entries.note: GOFO's step at the delivering facility, before the courier takes the parcel out.

entries.wording: Delivery failed, type: Recipient absent or address unreachable. We will redeliver as soon as possible. Please be patient and keep in touch.
entries.note: GOFO's failed attempt, with another one to come.

entries.wording: DESPATCHED AND ON ROUTE TO YODEL
entries.note: Yodel's record of the parcel on its way to it, written while JS Express's warehouse in China sent it out.
Yodel's record of its partner collecting the parcel from JS Express's warehouse in China, which accepted it the day before.
Yodel's agent taking the shipment from the destination airport.
Yodel's depot scan after the hand-off to the local courier.
The destination courier's delivery, with its place moved into the location.
USPS's first scan after the hand-off to the local courier; JS Express accepted the parcel in China.
The delivering post office's arrival scan, before the parcel goes out for delivery.
A partner's record of the parcel's data, written while the parcel was already flying; it moves nothing.
A partner's record of the parcel's data, after JS Express's warehouse had collected the parcel and on another clock; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Shipping Label Created, USPS Awaiting Item
entries.note: USPS's record of the label, written while JS Express's warehouse in China had the parcel; it moves nothing.
A partner's record of the parcel's data, written after JS Express had the order; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Package information is created in the system
entries.note: The destination courier's record of the parcel's data, written days before it has the parcel; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Your package is being prepared by the sender and will be handed over to us soon
entries.note: A courier's record of the parcel's data, in its own voice, before JS Express hands the parcel over; it moves nothing.
The destination courier's delivery forecast for the day, with its place moved into the location; no scan.
The destination post's record of the label, at the instant of Colissimo's own, written while JS Express had the parcel; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Votre Colissimo va bientôt nous être confié ! Il est en cours de préparation chez votre expéditeur.
entries.note: Colissimo's record of the label, written while JS Express had the parcel; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Votre colis est en transit sur nos plateformes logistiques.
Votre Colissimo est en cours de traitement sur le site de tri local.
L'adresse indiquée sur votre colis est incomplète ou incorrecte. Nous procédons à sa correction afin de permettre le bon acheminement de votre colis.
entries.note: Colissimo corrects the address and carries on, as its own copy reads it.

entries.wording: Votre Colissimo n'a pas pu vous être livré en raison d'un problème d'adresse. Il va être retourné à l'expéditeur.
entries.note: A return announced: the parcel is not back with its sender yet.

entries.wording: Votre colis est sur son site de distribution. Nous le préparons pour le mettre en livraison.
entries.note: Colissimo's sort into the delivery round, as La Poste reads its code MD1.

entries.wording: Votre colis est livré à son expéditeur à la suite d'un retour.

entries.note: JS Express's own status in Chinese, arrived and awaiting collection, with the country for its place.

entries.wording: 收件人地址不详或有误，派送失败，逾期退回或销毁的具体费用以账单为准，麻烦让收件人联系下当地
entries.english: The recipient's address is unclear or wrong and the delivery failed. Charges for a return or disposal after the deadline follow the bill; the recipient should contact the local office
entries.note: JS Express's own notice after the destination courier's failed attempt, its local office's number cut: the parcel waits for the recipient's answer before it is returned or disposed of.
